sentences.text:
The appellant is impugning the judgment and award dated 21.12.2023 passed in LAC No. 26/2013 on the file of the learned Additional Senior Civil Judge, Jamakhandi (hereinafter referred to as the trial Court).
Parties shall be referred to as per their ranking before the trial Court.
2. Brief facts of the case are that by Notification dated 16.12.2010 the land in Sy. No.
245/1+2+3/E/2 measuring 0- 12 guntas was acquired for the purpose of construction of percolation tank at Konnur village, Jamakhandi Taluk.
Impugning the award of the Land Acquisition Officer

,
landloser filed LAC No. 23/2023 by filing protest petition under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
Accordingly, the trial Court awarded compensation of Rs.4,62,250/- per acre with statutory benefits.
The landloser/appellant is before this Court impugning the said award.
3. Heard Smt. Ratnamala G.H. learned counsel for the appellant and Sri M.H. Patil, learned AGA for respondents.

It is brought to the notice of this Court that the trial Court in LAC No. 21/2013 which is connected to the present case, has awarded market value at Rs.5,52,500/- per acre and that the respondents have already satisfied the award.
The same is not disputed by the learned Additional Government Advocate.
He also submits that no appeal is preferred against the award passed by the Tribunal in LAC No. 21/2013.
He has no objection to award the aforesaid amount in this case also.

5. It is also brought to the notice of this Court that in other similar cases, i.e., M.F.A. No.
101259/2014 and 101257/2014 , this Court fixed the market value at Rs.5,52,500/- per acre.

Under such circumstances, the appellant is also entitled for award of compensation of Rs.5,52,500/- per acre, with all other statutory benefits.
6.

At this juncture, on the question of sufficiency of court fee paid, the learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has not paid the Court fee to the extent of the amount now awarded and she prays six weeks' time to pay the deficit Court fee.
She is permitted to do so.

Hence,
I proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:7490 ORDER
The Appeal is allowed in part.
Impugned judgment and award passed by learned Addl. Sr. Civil Judge, Jamakhandi, is modified.

It is held that appellant is entitled for compensation of Rs.5,52,500/- per acre with all Sumitra vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4321767/
2 statutory benefits.
